103: Result<std::vector<std::string>> SearchEngine::list_book_files(std::string_view dir) const {
104:     const std::filesystem::path directory{dir};
105:     std::error_code error;
106: 
107:     if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(directory, error) || error) {
108:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
109:     }
110: 
111:     std::vector<std::filesystem::path> book_paths;
112:     for (const std::filesystem::directory_entry& entry :
113:         std::filesystem::directory_iterator{directory, error}) {
114:         if (error) {
115:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
116:         }
117: 
118:         std::error_code entry_error;
119:         if (entry.is_regular_file(entry_error) && entry.path().extension() == ".txt") {
120:             book_paths.push_back(entry.path());
121:         }
122:     }
123: 
124:     if (error) {
125:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
126:     }
127: 
128:     std::ranges::sort(
129:         book_paths, {}, [](const std::filesystem::path& path) { return path.string(); });
130: 
131:     std::vector<std::string> files;

134:         files.push_back(path.string());

290: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
291:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
292:     if (words.empty()) {
293:         return {};
294:     }
295: 
296:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
297:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
298:         return {};
299:     }
300: 
301:     std::vector<Index> matches;
302:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
303:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
304:         bool is_phrase = true;
305: 
306:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
307:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
308:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
309:                 return {};
310:             }
311: 
312:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
313:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.line == start.line &&
314:                        index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
315:             });
316: 
317:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
318:                 is_phrase = false;
319:                 break;
320:             }
321: 
322:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
323:         }
324: 
325:         if (is_phrase) {
326:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
331:     return matches;
